Professional conduct information

Avv. Antonio Circosta is registered with the Bar Association of Reggio Calabria (Ordine degli Avvocati di Reggio Calabria).

Further information can be obtained directly by consulting the register of lawyers made available by the Italian National Bar Council (Consiglio Nazionale Forense) at the following link: https://www.consiglionazionaleforense.it/ricerca-avvocati.

Professional conduct policy of the Law Firm

Pursuant to Article 9 of the Italian Code of Conduct for Lawyers (Codice Deontologico Forense), Avv. Antonio Circosta practises the profession with independence, loyalty, fairness, probity, dignity, decorum, diligence and competence, taking into account the constitutional and social importance of the right of defence and respecting the principles of fair and loyal competition.

In order to protect the trust of his clients, he provides on this website information:

  • on his professional activity;
  • on the organisation of the firm;
  • on the specialisations and the academic and professional qualifications held.

The above information is provided in compliance with the principles of transparency, truthfulness, fairness and unambiguousness. Furthermore, the information provided is not misleading, disparaging or suggestive, and is in no way comparative.

All the information contained on this website refers exclusively to the nature and limits of the professional obligation.

Note: *Legislative Decree of 9 April 2003, No. 70 – Implementation of Directive 2000/31/EC on certain legal aspects of information society services in the internal market, in particular electronic commerce – link to the updated and consolidated version: https://www.normattiva.it.

This English version is provided for convenience only. In the event of any discrepancy, the Italian version shall prevail.
